label: Common strict order for the required mixed edges
term: common strict order for bearer and production edges
definition: Some single irreflexive transitive relation on Sum B E satisfies BearerPrior and ProductPrior for the same occurrence, bearer and production data.
note: The four interface clauses are the existing ones in DISAMB-MIXED-EXISTENTIAL-PRIORITY. This existence test places no constraints on the order beyond those four clauses. An interpretation as a specific metaphysical priority would require further warrant.
